listing.name: Crystal Defenders (Xbox Live Arcade) — Cristalis (Claudio5702)
listing.summary: A few people have played beta 1.10 according to the project. Online leaderboards and instant save states are unavailable; the player handles music loops. Native Linux remains experimental and is separate from running Windows through Proton. Portcove has not confirmed a playthrough. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Crystal Defenders XBLA title 58410989 package 18F4739D37853F8596CE621540680922AFE9F23A: 58126336 bytes, SHA-1 118C64C901976CD8E2B570D77B0A5E01C15C7A46. Its default.xex is 1658880 bytes, SHA-1 31A90704D4233F6E730714515CD5F20BF08D7F0D. Supply the package or its extracted default.xex and complete Media folder.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release’s native player and DarkLauncher to extract or import your own package on first start. The project compiles translated C++ when building its release; you still need your own game assets. Windows and experimental native Linux packages are separate. Use the project’s launcher for updates.
